bayts.text: I give thanks to Allah, Lord of creatures, with benefit, for a Book that has driven the enemies into headlong flight.
My breast has not inclined to any but my God, and toward my Lord my speech and my hearing have turned.
No doubt has entered my heart concerning what Allah has led to me, (all) gathered together.
The remembrance of my King has taken away every doubt, and has driven the enemies toward others than me, subdued.
Allah has threatened whoever hated me, (driving him) far away, toward other than my side, unheeded.
My life gives thanks to Allah, for the Gardens, with a Book through which benefit has appeared to me.
The heart has known that to the Best of creatures (Muḥammad) the Revelation came through the obeyed Trustworthy One (Gabriel).
O Ḥadīth of the Prophet, truly you are truth; toward you my writing has turned, by an obeyed command.
Toward you I turn with my pen and my ink; I never cease, with contentment, to abide in obedience.
You are, together with the Book, my intimate friend and my beloved; you have been for me (a support) portion after portion.
Through you my joy grows toward pure Gardens, without end or interruption.
They have fled, without turning toward me, those among creatures who hated me, with a final severance.
